name: start_quote
description: Start or update the quote once you have the caller's name, garaging ZIP, and prior insurance. Call before any driver or vehicle. Returns the state, the packages_sentence to read for that state, and whether a tort choice is required.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code where the car is parked overnight.

prior_insurance_months.description: Months of continuous auto insurance up to today. 0 if currently uninsured.

garaging_city.description: Michigan only: the city or township where the car is parked overnight, as the caller said it. Leave empty unless the system asked for it.

name: save_driver
description: Save one driver after collecting all six items and reading the license number back. Re-saving the same driver_index replaces it.

driver_index.description: 1 for the caller, then 2, 3, 4 for other household drivers.

license_state.description: Two-letter state that issued the license, e.g. NJ.

license_number.description: License number with a space between groups exactly as read back, e.g. 'T 5000 0000 0000 05'. Never merge groups or count zeros yourself; the system removes the spaces. Leave empty if the caller doesn't have it handy yet.

years_licensed.description: Years the driver has held a license.

tickets_3y.description: Number of traffic tickets in the last 3 years.

at_fault_accidents_3y.description: Number of at-fault accidents in the last 3 years.

dui_3y.description: True if any DUI or DWI in the last 3 years.

name: add_license
description: Add a license number to a driver who is already saved without one: later in the call, or after resume_quote. Never re-ask that driver's other questions. Read the number back and get a yes first.

driver_index.description: The saved driver's index (from resume_quote's license_needed, or the order you saved them in).

license_number.description: License number with a space between groups exactly as read back. Never merge groups or count zeros yourself.

license_state.description: Only if the caller says the license is from a different state than the one on file: the two-letter state. Otherwise leave empty.

name: save_vehicle
description: Save one vehicle by VIN (preferred, after reading it back) or by year, make, and model. Re-saving the same vehicle_index replaces it.

vin.description: VIN with a space between groups exactly as read back, e.g. '1HGC M826 33A0 04352', or empty string if not provided. The system removes the spaces.

year.description: Model year if no VIN, else 0.

make.description: Make if no VIN (e.g. Honda), else empty string.

model.description: Model if no VIN (e.g. Civic), else empty string.

usage.description: Primary use. Rideshare or delivery driving at any time counts as rideshare.

name: set_coverage
description: Record the coverage package and payment plan the caller chose.

pay_in_full.description: True to pay the six-month premium up front, false for monthly.

tort_option.description: Pennsylvania only: the caller's tort choice. Use full if they won't choose (the Pennsylvania default). Omit for New Jersey.

pip_medical.description: Michigan only: the caller's PIP medical choice. unlimited has no dollar cap; 500k and 250k cap it at $500,000 or $250,000 per person per crash. 250k_excluded is $250,000 with the household excluded because everyone has health insurance other than Medicare. 50k is $50,000, for Medicaid. opt_out is no PIP medical, for Medicare Parts A and B. Use unlimited if they won't choose. Leave empty outside Michigan.

pip_confirmed.description: Michigan only: true only after the caller confirmed the eligibility and agreed to the disclosure the system asked you to read for 250k_excluded, 50k or opt_out. Otherwise leave empty.

name: get_quote
description: Pull driving record, claims history, and prior insurance reports, run underwriting, and price the quote. Returns the price, factors, discrepancies, and quote_hash.

name: submit_application
description: Submit the application ONLY after spelling the applicant's name back letter by letter, reading back package, vehicles, drivers, and price, and hearing an explicit yes.

quote_hash.description: The quote_hash from the most recent get_quote result.

caller_confirmed.description: True only if the caller explicitly said yes to the read-back.

first_name.description: Applicant's first name exactly as the caller confirmed when you spelled it back.

last_name.description: Applicant's last name exactly as the caller confirmed when you spelled it back.

name: lookup_application
description: Look up an existing application when a caller asks about one. Ask for the applicant's last name first: without a matching last name only its status comes back, never the price or package.

application_number.description: The application number the caller read, digits only.

last_name.description: The applicant's last name as the caller gave it.

name: resume_quote
description: Returning callers only: after the caller chooses to continue and gives their date of birth, reopen their saved quote with the resume code from the 'This call' section.

resume_code.description: The resume code from the 'This call' section of your instructions.

date_of_birth.description: The caller's date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: flag_for_human
description: Record why the caller is being handed to a licensed agent. Always call this right before transfer_to_number, or, for declined_recording, right before ending the call.

summary.description: One sentence for the human agent: who is calling and what they need.
